name: Stovetop White Rice
source: Long-grain stovetop method, ~1:1.6 rice:water by weight
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs mostly clear; drain.
Combine rice, water and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to the lowest heat, and simmer 15 min without lifting the lid.
Off the heat, keep covered and rest 10 min.
Fluff with a fork and serve.
notes: ~1:1.6 rice:water by weight (200 g rice = about 1 cup). For softer rice go up to 360 g water.
